description: Per-session Firecracker sandbox with persistent disk
prompt: Use to run shell commands inside a private, per-session Firecracker micro-VM that persists installed software and data between turns. The VM is automatically woken on the next command and suspended when the session goes idle.

tools.name: exec
tools.desc: run a shell command inside the session's persistent fire VM; auto-wakes the VM if it was suspended

session_id.desc: optional davinci session id (one VM per session)

tools.name: start
tools.desc: explicitly boot or resume the session's fire VM on its persistent disk

tools.name: write
tools.desc: drop a file into the session's fire VM at a chosen path

tools.name: suspend
tools.desc: turn the session's fire VM off but KEEP its persistent disk — software and data survive

tools.name: delete
tools.desc: turn the session's fire VM off AND purge its persistent disk — destroys the sandbox

tools.name: status
tools.desc: report the session's fire VM last-known state
